description: Use this tool after you have a resource id and need a related published item that the catalog already records: the next or previous lesson, the course page, the song and its watch page, or a shared category or coloring gallery. It does not guess semantic similarity.

locale.description: Interface locale code from the 77-locale registry, such as en, ru, ar, or zh-Hans.

name: get_related_resources
title: Get related published resources
